bullets.text: A heatwave affected the town of Verlow from 22 June 2026, placing strain on the local power grid.

The Provincial Public Health Institute issued a heat warning for Verlow on the second day and deployed to the town, and by the fourth day the network operator Grennet Power had issued its own warning amid load shedding.
No casualty figures were reported within the window, but service at Verlow General Hospital was disrupted on the fourth day.
The public health response remained active at the end of the window, with the institute having requested assistance and the hospital disruption still unresolved.
The Provincial Public Health Institute issues a heat warning for Verlow on the morning of the second day.
The institute asks for assistance concerning Verlow and deploys to the town within the same hour.
Deployment notices from the institute continue through midday of the second day.
Service at Verlow General Hospital is disrupted on the morning of the fourth day; the network operator Grennet Power issues a warning.
Service at Verlow General Hospital was disrupted on the fourth day of the heatwave.
The primary hazard was extreme heat across Verlow, compounded by load shedding on the power network.
